name: Ahlam Mallak
title: Research & Development | Data Scientist | Machine Learning & AI | Real-Time Data & Industry 4.0 | Biomedical Data Analytics | Computational bioinformatics
education: PhD in Computer and Electrical Engineering, Siegen University
bio: I’m a scientist–engineer who enjoys finding patterns, asking questions and turning complex data into useful ideas. My work spans machine learning, real-time sensor systems, Industry 4.0 and biomedical data analytics and discovery.
aboutLong: My path through research and engineering has taken me across Europe, the Middle East and South Korea, connecting different disciplines through a shared interest in what we can learn—and build—with data and also with hardware. I hold a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and bring over 10 years of experience in machine learning, real-time data analysis, and large-scale data systems. I have developed data-driven solutions in academic and industry-oriented research, from detecting faults in industrial machinery to investigating biomedical data and computational bioinformatics. My experience includes data integration, statistical modeling, deep learning, scalable analytical workflows, and recently, robotics. What I enjoy most is the creativity of the problem-solving itself: exploring a question, experimenting with approaches, and developing something useful from the results. I’m particularly drawn to work that combines scientific curiosity with practical invention in both Software and hardware inventions and discoveries.
